QF.id: AIFM Fee Structure and Fund Performance_6

question.text: Vedant Capital is negotiating the hurdle rate for its maiden Category I venture capital AIF. What is the typical Indian-market hurdle rate range per Ch 9?

explanation.text: The Logic: Ch 9.2 states Indian AIF hurdle rates are typically 7-12% p.a. in INR, higher than international 5-8% USD benchmarks because Indian equity market historical averages are ~12%. The Trap: Option A is below the risk-free rate and too low. Option B is the typical IRR TARGET (different concept). Option D is unreasonably high. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-A tests the number; XIX-C requires the manager to benchmark against IRR expectations. Manager's Pro-Tip: When raising USD from offshore LPs into an India AIF, clearly state whether the hurdle is in INR (implying FX risk is with the LP) or USD (FX risk with the GP). Most GIFT City AIFs use USD hurdles with an FX carve-out.
